tasks.label: Build Web Server
tasks.command: gcc -std=c99 -Wall -Wextra -O2 -ICommon -Ibackend -DSQLITE_THREADSAFE=1 backend/server.c backend/database.c backend/geocoding.c backend/routing.c backend/http_client.c backend/cJSON.c backend/sqlite3.o Common/route.c Common/nearest_neighbor.c Common/branch_bound.c -o bin/delivery_server.exe -lws2_32

tasks.label: Build Console Application
tasks.command: gcc -std=c99 -Wall -Wextra -O2 -ICommon Common/route.c Common/nearest_neighbor.c Common/branch_bound.c Console/main.c -o bin/delivery_planner_console.exe

tasks.label: Run Automated Verification Suite
tasks.command: gcc -std=c99 -Wall -Wextra -O2 -ICommon Common/route.c Common/nearest_neighbor.c Common/branch_bound.c tests/verify_all.c -o bin/verify_all.exe && .\bin\verify_all.exe
